paragraphs: In [Avodah Zarah 33b](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.33b.6), Rabbi Yosna said in the name of Rabbi Ami.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked passage preserves both Rabbi titles and reports a ruling about vessels made of natron. Hyman’s supplied locator is לו:, 36b.
The supplied heading and the linked Gemara read יוסנא, Yosna.
